summary: MasterCraft Boat Holdings filed an 8-K to report its acquisition of Marine Products Corporation via a two-step merger. Under the terms, Marine Products shareholders received 0.232 MasterCraft shares plus $2.43 cash per share, implying a mixed cash-and-stock consideration. The exact price per share and premium are not stated in this excerpt. The board of both companies approved the transaction; no advisors are named. The deal closed on May 15, 2026, the filing date. Watch for post-close integration updates and potential dissenting shareholder litigation.
